evals.name: database-first-turn-confirmation-gate
evals.prompt: Create a database called reporting on our standalone postgres host i-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 in us-east-1. No specific owner needed. This is a simulated first-turn eval: inspect returns status=ok, deploymentType=standalone, nodeRole=none, serviceState=running, alreadyExists=false, and mapped data/WAL volumes on one SVM. Do not contact a live API.
evals.expected_output: Validates the simulated inspect result, presents the mapped-volume confirmation, and stops without running createdb in the initial request turn.
expectations: Uses scriptId inspect with DATABASE_NAME=reporting and interprets the simulated standalone + running result
Resolves and presents the mapped ONTAP data and WAL volumes for confirmation
Does not call aws ssm send-command from the operator machine
Does not run createdb or claim reporting exists in this initial request turn
Explains that volume confirmation and then a later explicit CREATE DATABASE confirmation are required

evals.name: database-post-confirmation-with-owner
evals.prompt: Continue a simulated PostgreSQL create-database conversation. In prior turns, inspect on standalone primary i-0fedcba987654321 in us-west-2 returned running, analytics absent, ownerExists=true for app_user, and mapped volumes; the operator confirmed those volumes; you then presented the CREATE DATABASE analytics OWNER app_user confirmation. The operator now replies: "Yes, create it." Simulate a successful createdb envelope with verified=true and owner=app_user. Do not contact a live API.
evals.expected_output: Treats this as the later-turn action confirmation, runs the allowlisted createdb operation, and validates the catalog owner from the simulated envelope.
expectations: Uses the prior inspect result showing ownerExists=true for app_user rather than repeating or skipping the preflight
Treats the current reply as a later-turn explicit confirmation for analytics owned by app_user
Creates the database with the specified owner (createdb --owner=app_user)
Verifies the owner via pg_get_userbyid/pg_database rather than assuming success

evals.name: database-duplicate-name-refused
evals.prompt: Create a database named billing on postgres host i-0aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa in us-east-1. (inspect with DATABASE_NAME shows billing already exists.)
evals.expected_output: Refuses to create billing because it already exists, without dropping or recreating it.
expectations: Inspect with DATABASE_NAME shows 'billing' already exists
Refuses to run createdb and does not drop/recreate the existing database
Explains to the user that the database already exists

evals.name: database-missing-owner-role-refused
evals.prompt: Create database 'reports' owned by 'nonexistent_role' on postgres host i-0bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb, eu-west-1. (nonexistent_role does not exist.)
evals.expected_output: Refuses because the requested owner role does not exist, rather than silently falling back to the cluster default owner.
expectations: Inspect with DATABASE_NAME/OWNER shows the requested owner role is missing
Refuses to create the database with cluster-default ownership as a silent fallback
Asks the user to create the role first or supply an existing owner

evals.name: database-invalid-identifier-rejected
evals.prompt: Create a postgres database called 'My Reports!' on host i-0ccccccccccccccc, us-east-2.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the invalid database identifier instead of quoting or sanitizing it.
expectations: Rejects the database name for failing ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$ instead of quoting or sanitizing it
Does not attempt createdb with the invalid name
Asks the user for a valid lowercase identifier

evals.name: database-ha-post-confirmation-routes-to-primary
evals.prompt: Continue a simulated HA PostgreSQL create-database conversation. Prior turns inspected i-0ddddddddddddddd in us-east-1 as deploymentType=ha and nodeRole=primary, identified standby i-0eeeeeeeeeeeeeee, confirmed mapped volumes, and presented the CREATE DATABASE testdb confirmation. The operator now replies: "Yes, create testdb." Simulate a createdb envelope with primary catalog verified=true and replicated=true, followed by standby inspect with DATABASE_NAME=testdb returning alreadyExists=true. Do not contact a live API.
evals.expected_output: Creates testdb on the resolved primary using a bare instanceId, then verifies the catalog and that the standby replayed the WAL.
expectations: Uses the prior inspect result that resolved the named host as the HA primary before attempting createdb
Treats the named host as the primary (nodeRole=primary) rather than refusing HA
Sends subsequent run-script calls with bare instanceId and omits databaseHostId
Verifies the new database from pg_database on the primary
Proves replication by inspecting the known standby with DATABASE_NAME=testdb

evals.name: database-no-premature-confirmation-treated-as-yes
evals.prompt: Please create a database called inventory on our postgres server.
evals.expected_output: Asks for source identity and region before running any createdb.
expectations: Asks for the missing source identity (inventory databaseHostId or unregistered sourceInstanceId) and region before doing anything
Does not run createdb in the same turn as the initial request
Only proceeds to the confirmation step once instance/region are known

evals.name: clone-first-turn-confirmation-gates
evals.prompt: Clone our standalone postgres instance i-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 (us-east-1) onto target host i-0fedcba987654321. Call it 'qa-clone', use port 5433, retention label 'qa-test'. Both hosts are on the same FSx SVM and same PostgreSQL major version, target has no active PGDATA and 5433 is free.
evals.expected_output: Completes source and target preflight, presents the mapped-volume confirmation, and explains the three later mutation gates without applying a mutation in the initial turn.
expectations: Resolves mapped ONTAP data and WAL volumes on the source via run-script before any mutation
Invokes the wlmdb POST .../pgsql/.../run-script endpoint rather than aws ssm send-command
Runs inspect on both source and target before any mutation
Presents three distinct confirmations: new snapshot, FlexClone volumes, and mount+start — not folded into one
Does not run cg-snapshot, cg-flexclone, or clone-recovery with --apply in the initial request turn
States that a fresh consistency-group snapshot will be used and both FlexClones must come from that same group snapshot
States that clone-recovery will sanitize inherited recovery state before starting the separate clone service
Never calls pg_resetwal
Does not claim clonedVolumes, a running service, or verified=true before the later confirmations and validation complete

evals.name: clone-version-mismatch-refused
evals.prompt: Clone postgres host i-0aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa onto i-0bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb, us-east-1, name 'mismatch-clone', port 5434, retention 'test'. (Source is PostgreSQL 17, target already has PostgreSQL 15 installed.)
evals.expected_output: Refuses the clone because the source and target PostgreSQL major versions differ.
expectations: Runs inspect on both hosts
Detects the pgVersionMajor mismatch (17 vs 15)
Refuses to proceed with any snapshot/FlexClone/mount step
Explains the version mismatch to the user instead of attempting a cross-version clone

evals.name: clone-active-target-pgdata-refused
evals.prompt: Clone postgres i-0ccccccccccccccc onto i-0ddddddddddddddd, us-west-2, name 'busy-target', port 5433, retention 'x'. (Target already has an active running PostgreSQL at the same intended mount path.)
evals.expected_output: Refuses to mount clone volumes over the target's active PGDATA and does not stop its running service.
expectations: Detects that the target already has an active PGDATA / running PostgreSQL
Refuses to mount clone volumes over the active PGDATA
Does not stop the target's existing PostgreSQL service to force the clone

evals.name: clone-port-conflict-refused
evals.prompt: Clone postgres i-0eeeeeeeeeeeeeeee onto i-0fffffffffffffff, eu-west-1, name 'port-clash', port 5432, retention 'x'. (Port 5432 is already in use on the target by another service.)
evals.expected_output: Refuses or asks for a different port because the requested clone port is already in use on the target.
expectations: Checks whether clonePort is already listening on the target before proceeding
Refuses to proceed or asks for a different port when 5432 is already in use
Does not start PostgreSQL on a conflicting port

evals.name: clone-ha-source-routes-to-primary
evals.prompt: Clone our postgres instance i-0111111111111111 onto i-0222222222222222, us-east-2, name 'ha-clone', port 5433, retention 'x'. (Source inspect reports deploymentType=ha, nodeRole=primary. Target is not in an HA pair.)
evals.expected_output: Clones the primary's data and WAL volumes onto the target instead of refusing HA, using a bare instanceId for source run-script calls.
expectations: Runs inspect on the source before any mutation
Uses the primary as the clone source rather than refusing HA
Sends source run-script calls with bare instanceId and omits databaseHostId
Does not clone from a standby's volume pair

evals.name: clone-single-confirmation-not-sufficient
evals.prompt: Yes, go ahead and clone the postgres instance i-0333333333333333 onto i-0444444444444444, us-east-1, name 'one-shot', port 5433, retention 'x'.
evals.expected_output: Treats the upfront yes as a request and still gates snapshot, FlexClone, and mount+start separately.
expectations: Does not treat the user's single upfront 'yes, go ahead' as satisfying all three separate confirmation gates

Still presents and waits for confirmation before the snapshot, before the FlexClone creation, and before mount+start individually (or clearly restates each stage's effect even if the user pre-authorized broadly)
Does not skip inspect or verification steps because the user said yes upfront

evals.name: clone-verification-failure-stops-and-reports
evals.prompt: Clone postgres i-0555555555555555 onto i-0666666666666666, us-east-1, name 'flaky-clone', port 5433, retention 'x'. (After mounting and starting, pg_is_in_recovery() unexpectedly returns true.)
evals.expected_output: Stops the target service on failed verification, avoids pg_resetwal, and reports every resource left behind for cleanup.
expectations: Detects that pg_is_in_recovery() did not return false as expected
Stops the PostgreSQL service on the target instead of leaving it running in an unverified state
Does not attempt pg_resetwal or any other automated recovery fix
Reports the created consistency group, snapshot, and FlexClone volumes so an operator can investigate/clean up

evals.name: clone-registered-source-unregistered-target
evals.prompt: Clone our inventory PostgreSQL host pg-host-abc123 (instance pg-inst-xyz from host detail, us-east-1) onto unregistered target i-0fedcba987654321. Call it 'qa-clone', port 5433, retention 'qa-test'.
evals.expected_output: Uses databaseHostId for the inventory source and a raw EC2 instance id for the unregistered target.
expectations: Uses databaseHostId/databaseInstanceId for the inventory source on run-script (host-detail instance list, not GET .../database-instances)
Uses raw instanceId (ec2InstanceId) for the unregistered clone target
Does not invent an EC2 id for the inventory source

evals.name: database-ssm-permission-missing-manual-steps
evals.prompt: Create a database called reporting on standalone postgres host i-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 in us-east-1. The first run-script POST returns HTTP 403 AccessDeniedException (Workload Factory credential cannot ssm:SendCommand).
evals.expected_output: Stops automating on the SSM permission failure and prints numbered operator steps for CREATE DATABASE on the existing cluster.
expectations: Does not retry via aws ssm send-command from the operator machine
Stops automating instead of guessing host or ONTAP state
Prints numbered operator steps to finish CREATE DATABASE on the existing cluster (shell on the host, confirm postgres running and existing data/WAL mounts, createdb, catalog verify)
Does not instruct the operator to provision new ONTAP volumes for CREATE DATABASE

evals.name: clone-ssm-permission-missing-manual-steps
evals.prompt: Clone standalone postgres i-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 onto i-0fedcba987654321, us-east-1, name 'qa-clone', port 5433, retention 'qa-test'. run-script fails with TargetNotConnected / instance not valid to receive commands.
evals.expected_output: Stops automating on the SSM connectivity failure and prints numbered operator steps for the FlexClone, mount, start, and verification.
expectations: Does not retry via aws ssm send-command from the operator machine
Stops automating instead of continuing to FlexClone or mount
Prints numbered operator steps covering crash-consistent CG snapshot, FlexClone of data and WAL from the same snapshot, NFS mount on the target, recovery sanitization, start, and verification
Tells the operator not to run pg_resetwal if verification fails

evals.name: database-ha-standby-redirected-with-confirmation
evals.prompt: Create database 'testdb' on inventory postgres host pg-host-ha, us-east-1. (inspect on the reachable node reports nodeRole=standby. GET .../pgsql/.../database-hosts returns nodeTopology.ec2Details with i-0primary000000000 and i-0standby00000000. Probing i-0primary000000000 reports nodeRole=primary.)
evals.expected_output: Does not run createdb on the standby; probes the peer, then asks confirmation naming the primary instance before creating testdb there.
expectations: Detects that the named/reachable node is a standby (nodeRole=standby)
Reads the peer EC2 id from GET .../pgsql/.../database-hosts nodeTopology.ec2Details rather than guessing
Probes the peer and confirms it is nodeRole=primary before mutating
Does not run createdb on the standby
Confirmation names the actual primary instance (Routed from the standby) and waits for yes

evals.name: database-ha-unregistered-standby-asks-peer
evals.prompt: Create database 'testdb' on unregistered postgres i-0standbyaaaaaaaaaa, us-east-1. (inspect reports nodeRole=standby, primaryHost=10.0.1.20. The host is not in inventory.)
evals.expected_output: Asks the operator for the primary's EC2 id (showing the primary_conninfo IP) instead of inventing one or creating on the standby.
expectations: Detects nodeRole=standby on the unregistered host
Asks the operator for the other node's EC2 id, showing primaryHost from the envelope
Does not invent an EC2 id or fsxadmin credentials for the peer
Does not run createdb on the standby

evals.name: database-wal-level-replica-not-treated-as-ha
evals.prompt: Create database 'testdb' on postgres host i-0ccccccccccccccc, us-east-1. (postgresql.conf has wal_level=replica, but pg_is_in_recovery is f, pg_stat_replication is empty, and pg_replication_slots is empty.)
evals.expected_output: Treats the host as standalone and creates testdb there; does not switch to bare-instanceId HA targeting.
expectations: Does not classify the host as HA solely because wal_level=replica
Treats nodeRole=none / deploymentType=standalone as the source
Does not ask for a peer node or drop databaseHostId targeting for a false HA detection

evals.name: clone-inherited-replication-slots-dropped
evals.prompt: Clone HA primary i-0primary000000000 onto i-0target0000000000, us-east-1, name 'slot-clone', port 5433, retention 'x'. (Source has physical slot slaveslot1. Target is not HA.)
evals.expected_output: Starts the clone after dropping inherited replication slots and stripping pg_hba replication lines, and refuses to report verified while slots remain.
expectations: Strips host replication lines from the clone's pg_hba.conf before start
Drops inherited replication slots via pg_drop_replication_slot after PostgreSQL is started
Does not report verified=true while pg_replication_slots is non-empty
Never calls pg_resetwal

evals.name: clone-onto-host-running-postgres
evals.prompt: Clone postgres i-0aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa onto i-0bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb, us-east-1, name 'beside-existing', port 5433, retention 'x'. (Target inspect with CLONE_* reports nodeRole=standby, serviceState=running on its own PGDATA, same pgVersionMajor, port 5433 free, no postgresql-beside-existing.service, clone mount paths unmounted.)
evals.expected_output: Accepts the running target as a valid sidecar destination, leaves its existing service untouched, and carries the existing cluster details into the later mount+start confirmation without claiming completion.
expectations: Does not refuse the target merely because it already runs PostgreSQL or has nodeRole != none
Plans postgresql-beside-existing.service instead of editing, restarting, or adding a drop-in to the target's postgresql.service
Names the target's existing cluster (PGDATA, port, nodeRole) in the mount+start confirmation and states that its service is untouched
Does not report the clone service running or verified=true before the separate mutation confirmations complete

evals.name: clone-no-consistency-group-yet-extra-gate
evals.prompt: Clone postgres i-0aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa onto i-0bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb, us-east-1, name 'first', port 5433, retention 'x'. (The SVM has no consistency group at all; a separate group already contains the data volume together with two unrelated volumes.)
evals.expected_output: Refuses to adopt the partially-matching group, and treats creating the correct data+WAL group as its own confirmation before the snapshot confirmation.
expectations: Does not adopt or snapshot a consistency group whose member set is not exactly the data and WAL volumes
Presents consistency-group creation as its own confirmation, separate from and before the snapshot confirmation
States that the group adopts the two existing volumes and creates no new volumes
Does not fold group creation, snapshot, FlexClone, and mount+start into one prompt

evals.name: clone-relinks-wal-and-clears-stale-lockfile
evals.prompt: Clone HA primary i-0primary000000000 onto that same host, us-east-1, name 'beside', port 5433, retention 'x'. (Source PGDATA /pgdata has pg_wal as an absolute symlink to /pglog/pg_wal, postgresql.conf sets data_directory = '/pgdata', and postmaster.pid names the live postmaster PID.)
evals.expected_output: Requires clone-recovery to re-point pg_wal, remove only the clone's stale postmaster.pid, and rewrite the clone's data_directory before start; it must not claim those actions ran before confirmation.
expectations: Requires the clone's inherited absolute pg_wal symlink to be replaced so it resolves inside the clone log mount, not source /pglog
Requires pg_wal resolution to be verified before start and start to abort if it still points outside the clone log mount
Requires deletion of postmaster.pid only from the clone data directory before start
Requires data_directory to be rewritten in the clone's postgresql.conf instead of relying on -D alone
States that source PGDATA and WAL remain untouched and does not claim clone-recovery already ran before confirmation

evals.name: clone-unit-name-conflict-refused
evals.prompt: Clone postgres i-0aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa onto i-0bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb, us-east-1, name 'dup', port 5433, retention 'x'. (Target already has a postgresql-dup.service unit from an earlier clone.)
evals.expected_output: Refuses because the clone's systemd unit name is already taken on the target, and asks for a different cloneName.
expectations: Passes CLONE_NAME (and other CLONE_* args) on inspect so sidecar conflict checks run
Detects unitConflict=true and refuses before any snapshot or FlexClone
Does not overwrite or adopt the existing postgresql-dup.service
Asks the operator for a different cloneName

evals.name: clone-flexclone-ontap-volume-names-no-hyphen
evals.prompt: Clone postgres i-0aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa onto i-0bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb, us-east-1, name 'bhaskar-clone', port 5433, retention '7d'. (Inspect is clean; volumes confirmed.)
evals.expected_output: Keeps cloneName bhaskar-clone for the systemd unit and mounts, but FlexClone volume names use underscores (no hyphen). Does not POST DATA_CLONE_VOLUME containing '-'.
expectations: CLONE_NAME / unit / mount paths may keep the hyphenated cloneName
Derives DATA_CLONE_VOLUME and WAL_CLONE_VOLUME with hyphens replaced by underscores (e.g. wlmdb_pgsqldata_bhaskar_clone)
Does not send an ONTAP volume, CG, or snapshot name containing '-'
Does not treat a 917888 hyphen error as 'volumes did not come online'
